reviews.title: Not sure
reviews.text: It’s very fantastic when thinking of fairytales as it definitely has a lot of options when it comes to playable classes or creatures unfortunately they are stuck behind a massive paywall and so each summon cost you about two dollars for one chance at a random character and so you get shards that collect to get a character. So far, I’ve only had one time where it didn’t give me a character out of the eight summons I’ve done. I have yet to get duplicates at least I don’t think I did. I’ve gotten two rares. So the drop rate seems OK but you’re talking at least $10 for a 10 pull. They have ads that you can watch to earn more prizes so definitely money hungry.  The storyline is kind of lame and I’m OK with that. There’s some dragon coaxing you through this storyline, which is really demonic. I think the initial summons are meant to give you light characters cause I guess there’s different types of characters.. They bombard you with ads anytime you open the game or go into certain windows certain sections of the game. Overall, I think the graphics are really nice. They did a pretty good job with the graphics. Definitely trying to be its own thing but so far not really landing on one thing. It’s better than raid shadow legends in my opinion because I feel like the graphics were better in raid but the storyline kind of immerses you a little bit more in this one. Feels a little more in control, even though it’s the same concept. And you get more players to choose from in a match. But losing one character in a match will cost you a star and you gotta get three stars in order to fully pass the level.

reviews.title: Nothing like the ads!

reviews.title: I mean, why lie?
reviews.text:
So, the game is good. By the time you are level 50 you have hours of free daily content. There are crashes and some Tournament hackers, but overall it can be fun. 

But, it’s not really explained that Events start as Free Story events. The U.I. is painful to look at with so many pop ups. Also, the absolute spam you are hit with every time you hit the home button will actually break you mentally. It destroys the fun. 

I would say overall, I have to be fair. If it wasn’t for the true spam from the home button. Given the generous content, good graphics, and other things the game does well. I would give the game a 4. It isn’t like the best game ever but it is a good game. Unfortunately I give it a 3.5 because of how spammy they are trying to get their money.

reviews.title: played for years
reviews.text:
Great graphics.   Fun.   A little addictive.    

Be very careful about purchases.   They use every trick in the book to get you to pay for things.   Campaign energy, a stray piece of equipment to level up equipment.   Just budget yourself and track it.   Otherwise it can get quite excessive.

One annoyance - new characters and factions are way too strong.   But I guess thats their income stream.

Bottom line is that its a fun game but be visible about your game budget.

reviews.title: It’s close
reviews.text: Pros: it looks pretty good , lots of variety, not overly expensive, interface is easy and clean, cool animations, quick painless matches. Cons: unable to adjust any settings, pvp is full of smurfs, multiple confusing currencies, a few minutes after reset you’ll be out of things to do, slow starter, way WAY to many hero’s needed to fully enjoy, last but not least the dreaded hidden team synergies games are annoying DISPLAY them so newbies don’t waste the little offered on useless characters!!!
